recent_recalls.title: Bodum USA Recalls 5.9 Million French Press Coffee Makers with Replaceable Glass Carafes Due to Risk of Serious Burn Injury
recent_recalls.product_name: Bodum French Press coffee makers with 8-cup and 12-cup replaceable glass carafes (Bistro, Brazil, Caffettiera, Chambord, Crema, Java, Jesper, and Kenya models)
recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The carafe can unexpectedly break during use if the glass carafe is damaged or cracked, including by use of a metal spoon to stir the coffee, posing a risk of serious burn injuries.
recent_recalls.injuries_reported: Bodum USA has identified 70 reports of carafes breaking during use, including 48 reports of burns to consumers
recent_recalls.retailers: Target, Walmart, and coffee and home goods stores nationwide and online at Bodum.com, Amazon.com, Target.com, Walmart.com and other online retailers from 1974 through October 2026 for about $15 to $65.
recent_recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using metal spoons or utensils to stir coffee in the glass carafe immediately and contact Bodum to receive a plastic Bodum stirring spoon and warning label. The label reminds consumers not to use cracked or damaged carafes and not to use metal spoons to stir contents in the glass carafe in order to avoid damaging the glass, which can lead to breakage during use.

recent_recalls.title: DREO Recalls DR-HSH015 Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
recent_recalls.units_affected: About 338,800 (In addition, about 36,300 were sold in Canada)
recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The recalled space heaters can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards.
recent_recalls.injuries_reported: DREO has received 17 reports of space heaters igniting, three resulting in property damage and one in a burn injury to the hand.
recent_recalls.retailers: Costco stores nationwide and online at Dreo.com, BestBuy.com, Kohls.com, Lowes.com, QVC.com, HomeDepot.com, B2BRenew.com and Costco.com from September 2025 through October 2026 for between $70 and $110.
recent_recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled space heaters immediately and contact DREO for a free replacement space heater. Consumers will be asked to unplug the space heater, destroy it by cutting the electrical cord and follow instructions to send a photo of the destroyed heater.

recent_recalls.title: Fashion Brand Apparel Recalls QZH.DUAO Pajama Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standards for Children’s Sleepwear
recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The recalled children’s pajama sets violate the mandatory safety standards for children’s sleepwear, posing a risk of serious burn injuries.
recent_recalls.retailers:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from February 2026 through July 2026 for about $23.
recent_recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled pajama sets immediately and contact Fashion Brand Apparel for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the pajamas in half and email a photo of the destroyed pajama set to qzh.duaoproductrecall@outlook.com to receive the refund. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed product.

recent_recalls.title: HAIARA Power Banks Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold on Amazon.com by Mitrytech
recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The power bank’s lithium battery can explode and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers.
recent_recalls.injuries_reported: Mitrytech has been made aware of 600 reports of fire and other thermal incidents, including three reports of burn injuries and nine reports of property damage.
recent_recalls.retailers: Amazon.com from May 2025 through September 2026 for between $18 to $22.
recent_recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled power banks immediately. Consumers who purchased their power banks on Amazon.com from Mitrytech should contact Mitrytech for instructions on how to receive a full refund. To receive a refund, consumers will be required to submit a photo of their recalled power bank with the word “recalled” written on it in permanent marker and confirm disposal of the power bank in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

recent_recalls.title: Harkla Recalls Children’s Sensory Swings Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
recent_recalls.units_affected: About 25,541 (In addition, about 5,534 were sold in Canada)
recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The recalled swings’ ceiling hook can separate from its plate, posing a risk of serious injury from a fall hazard.
recent_recalls.injuries_reported: Harkla has received 29 reports of the swing’s ceiling hook separating, including 14 injuries that resulted in two concussions, a broken arm, bumps and bruises.
recent_recalls.retailers: Sensory Tool House, Hammer & Jacks, Loaded Sensory and Renew (Faire), and online at Amazon.com and Harkla.co from March 2020 through December 2025 for between $100 and $130.

recent_recalls.title: Longjili Trading Recalls Pamag Pieeoo Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability
recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The recalled mattresses violate the mandatory flammability standard for mattresses, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire.
recent_recalls.retailers:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com in March 2026 for between $80 and $95.
recent_recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled mattresses immediately and contact Longjili Trading for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the mattress by writing in permanent marker “RECALLED,” on the top surface of the mattress and send a photo of the marked mattress to Pamagpieeoo@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

recent_recalls.title: NTI and HTP Brand Gas Boilers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire, Carbon Monoxide (CO) Poisoning and Impact Hazards; Manufactured by Ariston, formerly NTI Boilers
recent_recalls.product_name: NTI and HTP residential gas boilers
recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The condensate dish inside the boiler can crack during a delayed ignition, allowing unburned gas to build up inside the sealed cabinet. If the gas ignites, the front cover can suddenly detach, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire, carbon monoxide (CO) poisoning, and impact hazards.
recent_recalls.injuries_reported: The firm has received 34 reported incidents of the condensate dish breaking, including three reports of the front cover detaching from the boiler. In one reported incident the technician servicing the boiler sustained a broken jaw.
recent_recalls.retailers: Independent heating and plumbing contractors and wholesale distributors nationwide from May 2021 through July 2026 for between $3,200 and $7,700.
recent_recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled boilers immediately and contact Ariston to schedule a free repair by a certified technician. Consumers who must continue using the boiler while awaiting repair should have working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms in their homes.

recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The recalled nursing pillows violate the mandatory safety standards for nursing pillows because they can obstruct an infant’s breathing, posing a serious risk of injury or death from suffocation.
recent_recalls.retailers:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from April 2026 through September 2026 for between $30 and $40.
recent_recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the nursing pillows immediately and contact PILLANI for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to send a photo of the product and be provided with disposal instructions. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

recent_recalls.title: RootStim Recalls Minoxidil Hair Regrowth Treatment Bottles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Child Poisoning; Violate Mandatory Standard for Child-Resistant Packaging
recent_recalls.product_name: RootStim 5% Minoxidil Foam Hair Regrowth Treatment with Rosemary and Biotin, RootStim Minoxidil Hair Regrowth Treatment 5% Minoxidil Rosemary & Biotin and RootStim Minoxidil Hair Regrowth Treatment 5% Minoxidil with Rosemary
recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The recalled hair regrowth products contain minoxidil, which must be in child-resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The bottle is not child-resistant, posing a risk of serious injury or death from poisoning if the contents are ingested by young children.
recent_recalls.retailers:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from August 2025 through February 2026 for between $20 and $40.
recent_recalls.remedy: Consumers should secure the recalled products out of sight and reach of children immediately and contact RootStim for instructions on receiving a replacement product. Consumers will be asked to write “RECALLED” on the bottle, discard the bottle and send a photo of the discarded bottle to finergraceing@gmail.com.

recent_recalls.title: SOOWERY Recalls 8-Drawer Fabric Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units
recent_recalls.hazard_summary: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risks of serious injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the mandatory safety standards as required by the STURDY Act.
recent_recalls.retailers:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from December 2025 through August 2026 for about $106.
recent_recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall, place them in an area that children cannot access and contact SOOWERY for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “RECALLED” on the top, front and sides of the dresser, remove all drawers and send photos of the marked and disassembled dresser to SOOWERYrecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the product.

high_exposure_recalls.title: 3M Company Recalls Scotch™ Thermal Laminators Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard
high_exposure_recalls.hazard_summary: The recalled thermal laminators can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
high_exposure_recalls.injuries_reported: The firm has received 63 reports of the laminators smoking, melting and overheating, including five reports of the laminators catching fire and one report of minor property damage. No injuries have been reported.
high_exposure_recalls.retailers:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from June 2024 through September 2026 for between $44 and $56.
high_exposure_recalls.remedy: Consumers should stop using and unplug the recalled thermal laminators immediately and contact 3M Company to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to fill out the online recall registration form at https://www.scotchbrand.com/3M/en_US/scotch-brand/tl1302Z-laminator-recall/, confirm that their laminator is included in the recall and upload a photograph of the laminator with the unplugged power cord cut. The refund, in the form of a check, will be mailed to the consumer upon receipt of the completed form and confirmation that the laminator's power cord has been cut. Consumers should dispose of the recalled laminator in accordance with local and state laws governing electronics recycling.
